title: Smoky Butternut Squash Quiche
description: A creamy quiche filled with roasted butternut squash and a hint of smokiness.
instructions: Roll out the quiche crust and place it in a pie dish.
In a pan, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the cubed butternut squash and smoked paprika. Cook until the squash is tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and grated cheese.
Pour the egg mixture over the squash mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the filling into the pie crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the quiche is set and golden brown.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
